title: rewards.fraud.flagged v1
description: Emitted when the AI fraud detector places an earn into pending_review. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-rewards-go, EventPublisher.PublishFraudFlagged (internal/service/events_publisher.go:249, event_type stamped at line 250). Added 2026-07-03 (DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-rewards, option A2) -- this event type had no registered schema before, so it always fell into ErrNoSchema fail-open. In production (real DB pool) this event is routed through OutboxEventPublisher.PublishFraudFlagged (internal/service/outbox_event_publisher.go:105, called from rewards.go:499) which relays via the alebrije-common-go outbox poller onto the enveloped events:rewards SSOT stream -- the shape this schema describes. NOTE: the pool-less fallback path (rewards.go:538, tests only) instead XADDs the Event struct FLAT (no envelope, no data-nesting) onto the bare rewards.fraud.flagged stream via events_publisher.go -- that shape is out of scope for this schema and is not expected in prod traffic.

user_id.description: Rewards member whose earn was flagged for review.

amount.description: Points amount of the earn attempt that triggered the fraud flag (rewards.go req.Amount).

reason.description: Original earn reason (req.Reason), unrelated to the fraud verdict itself -- the verdict rides in metadata.status.

account_id.description: Rewards account the pending-review earn is attached to (tx.AccountID).

transaction_id.description: Ledger transaction id of the pending_review row (tx.ID).

balance_after.description: Account balance after this transaction (unaffected while pending review, but carried for audit).

reference.description: Free-form reference to the originating entity (req.Reference).

risk_score.description: Fraud detector score that triggered the flag (fraudScore). Type varies with the detector implementation.

status.description: Ledger transaction status at flag time (e.g. pending_review).

metadata.description: Merges the caller-supplied earn metadata (req.Metadata) with risk_score + status (rewards.go mergeMetadata). Unknown keys pass through -- forward compatible.
